49: static size_t url_encode(const char *src, char *dst, size_t dst_size)
50: {
51:     static const char hex[] = "0***WIFI_PSK_REDACTED***ABCDEF";
52:     size_t pos = 0;
53:     for (; *src && pos < dst_size - 3; src++) {
54:         unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*src;
55:         if ((c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') ||
56:             (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '~') {
57:             dst[pos++] = c;
58:         } else if (c == ' ') {
59:             dst[pos++] = '+';
60:         } else {
61:             dst[pos++] = '%';
62:             dst[pos++] = hex[c >> 4];
63:             dst[pos++] = hex[c & 0x0F];
64:         }
65:     }
66:     dst[pos] = '\0';
67:     return pos;
68: }

41: /**
42:  * Validate that path resolves to a location under AGENT_DATA_DIR.
43:  * Uses realpath() to resolve symlinks, preventing symlink escape attacks.
44:  * Falls back to raw path check if the file does not yet exist.
45:  */
46: static bool validate_path(const char *path)
47: {
48:     if (!path) {
49:         return false;
50:     }
51: 
52:     size_t dlen = strlen(AGENT_DATA_DIR);
53: 
54:     /* Quick reject: raw path must at least start with data dir */
55:     if (strncmp(path, AGENT_DATA_DIR, dlen) != 0
56:         || (path[dlen] != '/' && path[dlen] != '\0')) {
57:         return false;
58:     }
59: 
60:     /* Reject explicit traversal components */
61:     if (strstr(path, "..") != NULL) {
62:         return false;
63:     }
64: 
65:     /* Resolve symlinks to get the real path */
66:     char resolved[PATH_MAX];
67: 
68:     if (realpath(path, resolved) != NULL) {
69:         /* File exists — verify resolved path is still under data dir */
70:         if (strncmp(resolved, AGENT_DATA_DIR, dlen) != 0
71:             || (resolved[dlen] != '/' && resolved[dlen] != '\0')) {
72:             syslog(LOG_WARNING,
73:                    "[%s] Path escaped data dir via symlink: %s -> %s\n",
74:                    TAG, path, resolved);
75:             return false;
76:         }
77:     }
78: 
79:     /* If realpath fails (file doesn't exist yet), the raw path checks
80:      * above are sufficient — no symlink to follow. */
81: 
82:     return true;
83: }

237:     const char *old_str = cJSON_GetStringValue(cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "old_string"));
238:     const char *new_str = cJSON_GetStringValue(cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "new_string"));
239:

248:         snprintf(output, output_size,

261:         snprintf(output, output_size, "Error: file not found: %s", path);
262:         cJSON_Delete(root);
263:         return ERROR;
264:     }

266:     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);

268:     fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);

271:         snprintf(output, output_size, "Error: file too large or empty (%ld bytes)", file_size);
272:         fclose(f);

278:     size_t new_len = strlen(new_str);
279:     size_t max_result = (size_t)file_size + (new_len > old_len ? new_len - old_len : 0) + 1;
280: 
281:     char *buf    = malloc((size_t)file_size + 1);
282:     char *result = malloc(max_result);

306:     memcpy(result,                        buf,           prefix_len);

332: static size_t list_dir_recursive(const char *dir_path, const char *prefix,
333:                                   char *output, size_t output_size, size_t off,
334:                                   int *count, int depth)
335: {
336:     if (depth > 4) return off;  /* prevent infinite recursion */
337: 
338:     DIR *dir = opendir(dir_path);
339:     if (!dir) return off;
340: 
341:     struct dirent *ent;
342:     while ((ent = readdir(dir)) != NULL && off < output_size - 1) {
343:         /* Skip . and .. */
344:         if (strcmp(ent->d_name, ".") == 0 || strcmp(ent->d_name, "..") == 0)
345:             continue;
346: 
347:         char full_path[512];
348:         snprintf(full_path, sizeof(full_path), "%s/%s", dir_path, ent->d_name);
349: 
350:         if (prefix && strncmp(full_path, prefix, strlen(prefix)) != 0) continue;
351: 
352:         struct stat st;
353:         if (stat(full_path, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
354:             off += snprintf(output + off, output_size - off, "%s/\n", full_path);
355:             (*count)++;
356:             off = list_dir_recursive(full_path, prefix, output, output_size, off, count, depth + 1);
357:         } else {
358:             off += snprintf(output + off, output_size - off, "%s\n", full_path);
359:             (*count)++;
360:         }
361:     }
362:     closedir(dir);
363:     return off;

99: /* Rebuild tools JSON under lock. Only rebuilds when dirty flag is set. */
100: static void build_tools_json_locked(void)
101: {
102:     if (!s_tools_dirty) {
103:         return;
104:     }
105: 
106:     cJSON* arr = cJSON_CreateArray();
107: 
108:     for (int i = 0; i < s_tool_count; i++) {
109:         cJSON* tool = cJSON_CreateObject();
110:         cJSON_AddStringToObject(tool, "name", s_tools[i].name);
111:         cJSON_AddStringToObject(tool, "description", s_tools[i].description);
112:         cJSON* schema = cJSON_Parse(s_tools[i].input_schema_json);
113:         if (schema)
114:             cJSON_AddItemToObject(tool, "input_schema", schema);
115:         cJSON_AddItemToArray(arr, tool);
116:     }
117: 
118: #ifdef CONFIG_AI_AGENT_MCP
119:     char* mcp_json = mcp_bridge_get_tools_json();
120:     if (mcp_json) {
121:         cJSON* mcp_arr = cJSON_Parse(mcp_json);
122:         if (mcp_arr && cJSON_IsArray(mcp_arr)) {
123:             cJSON* item = NULL;
124:             cJSON_ArrayForEach(item, mcp_arr)
125:             {
126:                 cJSON_AddItemToArray(arr, cJSON_Duplicate(item, 1));
127:             }
128:         }
129:         cJSON_Delete(mcp_arr);
130:         free(mcp_json);
131:     }
132: #endif
133: 
134:     /* Collect tools from all registered providers */
135:     for (int p = 0; p < s_provider_count; p++) {
136:         if (!s_providers[p].get_tools) {
137:             continue;
138:         }
139:         char* provider_json = s_providers[p].get_tools();
140:         if (provider_json) {
141:             cJSON* provider_arr = cJSON_Parse(provider_json);
142:             if (provider_arr && cJSON_IsArray(provider_arr)) {
143:                 cJSON* item = NULL;
144:                 cJSON_ArrayForEach(item, provider_arr)
145:                 {
146:                     cJSON_AddItemToArray(arr, cJSON_Duplicate(item, 1));
147:                 }
148:             }
149:             cJSON_Delete(provider_arr);
150:             free(provider_json);
151:         }
152:     }
153: 
154:     free(s_tools_json);
155:     s_tools_json = cJSON_PrintUnformatted(arr);
156:     s_tools_dirty = false;
157:     cJSON_Delete(arr);
158:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Tools JSON built (%d builtin + %d providers)\n",
159:         TAG, s_tool_count, s_provider_count);
160: }

162: void tool_registry_rebuild_json(void) { build_tools_json_locked(); }

533:     char *output, size_t output_size)
534: {
535:     /* Security guard check before any tool execution */
536:     size_t input_len = input_json ? strlen(input_json) : 0;
537:     tool_guard_result_t guard = tool_guard_check(name, input_json, input_len);
538: 
539:     if (guard != GUARD_ALLOW) {
540:         const char *reason = "unknown";
541:         switch (guard) {
542:         case GUARD_DENY_DISABLED:
543:             reason = "tool disabled by config";
544:             break;
545:         case GUARD_DENY_RATE_LIMIT:
546:             reason = "rate limit exceeded";
547:             break;
548:         case GUARD_DENY_INPUT_SIZE:
549:             reason = "input too large";
550:             break;
551:         case GUARD_DENY_INPUT_INVALID:
552:             reason = "invalid input";
553:             break;
554:         default:
555:             break;
556:         }
557:         syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] Tool '%s' blocked: %s\n",
558:                TAG, name ? name : "(null)", reason);
559:         snprintf(output, output_size,
560:                  "Error: tool '%s' blocked — %s",
561:                  name ? name : "(null)", reason);
562:         return ERROR;
563:     }
564: 
565:     /* Try builtin tools first */
566:     for (int i = 0; i < s_tool_count; i++) {
567:         if (strcmp(s_tools[i].name, name) == 0) {
568:             syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Executing tool: %s\n", TAG, name);
569:             int ret = s_tools[i].execute(input_json, output, output_size);
570:             if (ret == OK) {
571:                 tool_guard_record_call(name);
572:             }
573:             return ret;
574:         }
575:     }
576: 
577:     /* Try MCP bridge */
578: #ifdef CONFIG_AI_AGENT_MCP
579:     if (mcp_bridge_execute(name, input_json, output, output_size) == OK) {
580:         syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Executed MCP tool: %s\n", TAG, name);
581:         tool_guard_record_call(name);
582:         return OK;
583:     }
584: #endif
585: 
586:     /* Try registered providers */
587:     for (int p = 0; p < s_provider_count; p++) {
588:         if (!s_providers[p].execute) {
589:             continue;
590:         }
591:         int ret = s_providers[p].execute(name, input_json, output, output_size);
592:         if (ret == OK) {
593:             syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Executed %s tool: %s\n",
594:                    TAG, s_providers[p].name, name);
595:             tool_guard_record_call(name);
596:             return OK;
597:         }
598:     }
599: 
600:     syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] Unknown tool: %s\n", TAG, name);
601:     snprintf(output, output_size, "Error: unknown tool '%s'", name);

263: /**
264:  * Parse first line as title: expects "# Title"
265:  * Returns pointer past "# " or the line itself if no prefix.
266:  */
267: static const char *extract_title(const char *line, size_t len, char *out, size_t out_size)
268: {
269:     const char *start = line;
270:     if (len >= 2 && line[0] == '#' && line[1] == ' ') {
271:         start = line + 2;
272:         len -= 2;
273:     }
274: 
275:     /* Trim trailing whitespace/newline */
276:     while (len > 0 && (start[len - 1] == '\n' || start[len - 1] == '\r' || start[len - 1] == ' ')) {
277:         len--;
278:     }
279: 
280:     size_t copy = len < out_size - 1 ? len : out_size - 1;
281:     memcpy(out, start, copy);
282:     out[copy] = '\0';
283:     return out;
284: }

286: /**
287:  * Extract description: text between the first line and the first blank line.
288:  */
289: static void extract_description(FILE *f, char *out, size_t out_size)
290: {
291:     size_t off = 0;
292:     char line[256];
293: 
294:     while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f) && off < out_size - 1) {
295:         size_t len = strlen(line);
296: 
297:         /* Stop at blank line or section header */
298:         if (len == 0 || (len == 1 && line[0] == '\n') ||
299:             (len >= 2 && line[0] == '#' && line[1] == '#')) {
300:             break;
301:         }
302: 
303:         /* Skip leading blank lines */
304:         if (off == 0 && line[0] == '\n') continue;
305: 
306:         /* Trim trailing newline for concatenation */
307:         if (line[len - 1] == '\n') {
308:             line[len - 1] = ' ';
309:         }
310: 
311:         size_t copy = len < out_size - off - 1 ? len : out_size - off - 1;
312:         memcpy(out + off, line, copy);
313:         off += copy;
314:     }
315: 
316:     /* Trim trailing space */
317:     while (off > 0 && out[off - 1] == ' ') off--;
318:     out[off] = '\0';
319: }

321: size_t skill_loader_build_summary(char *buf, size_t size)
322: {
323:     /*
324:      * On Vela/NuttX we have real directories, so we can simply opendir
325:      * on the skills directory and iterate over .md files.
326:      * (Original version used flat namespace readdir from mount root.)
327:      */
328:     DIR *dir = opendir(AGENT_SKILLS_DIR);
329:     if (!dir) {
330:         syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] Cannot open skills directory for enumeration: %s\n", TAG, AGENT_SKILLS_DIR);
331:         buf[0] = '\0';
332:         return 0;
333:     }
334: 
335:     size_t off = 0;
336:     struct dirent *ent;
337: 
338:     while ((ent = readdir(dir)) != NULL && off < size - 1) {
339:         const char *name = ent->d_name;
340:         size_t name_len = strlen(name);
341: 
342:         /* Match .md files only */
343:         if (name_len < 4) continue;
344:         if (strcmp(name + name_len - 3, ".md") != 0) continue;
345: 
346:         /* Skip hidden files */
347:         if (name[0] == '.') continue;
348: 
349:         /* Build full path */
350:         char full_path[256];
351:         snprintf(full_path, sizeof(full_path), "%s%s", AGENT_SKILLS_DIR, name);
352: 
353:         FILE *f = fopen(full_path, "r");
354:         if (!f) continue;
355: 
356:         /* Read first line for title */
357:         char first_line[128];
358:         if (!fgets(first_line, sizeof(first_line), f)) {
359:             fclose(f);
360:             continue;
361:         }
362: 
363:         char title[64];
364:         extract_title(first_line, strlen(first_line), title, sizeof(title));
365: 
366:         /* Read description (until blank line) */
367:         char desc[256];
368:         extract_description(f, desc, sizeof(desc));
369:         fclose(f);
370: 
371:         /* Append to summary */
372:         off += snprintf(buf + off, size - off,
373:             "- **%s**: %s (read with: read_file %s)\n",
374:             title, desc, full_path);
375:     }
376: 
377:     closedir(dir);
378: 
379:     buf[off] = '\0';
380:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Skills summary: %d bytes\n", TAG, (int)off);
381:     return off;
382: }

384: /* ── Hot-reload support ──────────────────────────────────────── */

386: static uint32_t s_last_skill_hash;
387: 
388: /* Simple hash of directory listing: file count + total size */
389: static uint32_t compute_skills_hash(void)
390: {
391:     DIR *dir = opendir(AGENT_SKILLS_DIR);
392:     if (!dir) {
393:         return 0;
394:     }
395: 
396:     uint32_t hash = 5381;
397:     struct dirent *ent;
398: 
399:     while ((ent = readdir(dir)) != NULL) {
400:         const char *name = ent->d_name;
401:         size_t name_len = strlen(name);
402: 
403:         if (name_len < 4 || strcmp(name + name_len - 3, ".md") != 0) {
404:             continue;
405:         }
406:         if (name[0] == '.') {
407:             continue;
408:         }
409: 
410:         /* Hash filename */
411:         for (size_t i = 0; i < name_len; i++) {
412:             hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + (unsigned char)name[i];
413:         }
414: 
415:         /* Hash file size + mtime (detects content changes) */
416:         char path[256];
417:         snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s%s", AGENT_SKILLS_DIR, name);
418:         struct stat st;
419:         if (stat(path, &st) == 0) {
420:             hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + (uint32_t)st.st_size;
421:             hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + (uint32_t)st.st_mtime;
422:         }
423:     }
424: 
425:     closedir(dir);
426:     return hash;
427: }

429: bool skill_loader_check_changed(void)
430: {
431:     uint32_t current = compute_skills_hash();
432:     if (s_last_skill_hash == 0) {
433:         s_last_skill_hash = current;
434:         return false;
435:     }
436:     if (current != s_last_skill_hash) {
437:         s_last_skill_hash = current;
438:         return true;
439:     }
440:     return false;
441: }

443: void skill_loader_refresh(void)
444: {
445:     s_last_skill_hash = compute_skills_hash();
446:     /* Invalidate tool registry so next get_tools_json rebuilds */
447:     tool_registry_invalidate();
448:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] Skills refreshed (hash=%08x)\n",
449:         TAG, s_last_skill_hash);

1: # agent_deploy · 设备端 Agent 部署资产
2: 
3: 本目录是「朝夕」Agent 的完整部署资产，刷机后用 `tools/deploy_assets.ps1` 推送到开发板即可使用。
4: 
5: > **数据根目录**：ai_agent 的数据根目录（下称 `<BASE>`）在旧固件为 `/data/ai_agent`，工作区最新源码已改为 `/data/agent`（`agent_config.h`）。部署脚本会自动探测，下表以 `<BASE>` 代指。
6: 
7: ## 文件清单
8: 
9: | 文件 | 部署路径 | 用途 |
10: |------|----------|------|
11: | `SOUL.md` | `<BASE>/config/SOUL.md` | Agent 人格设定（语气、价值观、行为准则） |
12: | `USER.md` | `<BASE>/config/USER.md` | 用户信息模板（姓名、城市、职业、偏好） |
13: | `MEMORY.md` | `<BASE>/memory/MEMORY.md` | 长期记忆模板（项目信息、用户习惯，Agent 运行时读写） |
14: | `cron.json` | `<BASE>/cron.json` | 定时任务配置（每日简报、久坐提醒、饮水提醒） |
15: | `daily-briefing.md` | `<BASE>/skills/daily-briefing.md` | 每日简报 Skill（覆盖内置同名） |
16: | `reminder.md` | `<BASE>/skills/reminder.md` | 定时提醒 Skill（覆盖内置同名） |
17: | `note-taker.md` | `<BASE>/skills/note-taker.md` | 语音记事 Skill（覆盖内置同名） |
18: | `health-reminder.md` | `<BASE>/skills/health-reminder.md` | 健康提醒 Skill（纯新增，内置无此 skill） |
19: 
20: ## Skill 加载原理
21: 
22: 框架的 skill 机制在 `packages/ai_agent/src/tools/skill_loader.c`，流程为：
23: 
24: 1. **启动写入**：`skill_loader_init()` 将 10 个内置 skill（weather、daily-briefing、skill-creator、system-health、reminder、note-taker、translate、news-digest、feishu-test、task-manager）写入 `/data/agent/skills/`；**若同名文件已存在则直接跳过，不会覆盖**（`install_builtin()` 中 `fopen(path, "r")` 成功即返回）。
25: 2. **摘要注入**：每次构建 system prompt 时，`skill_loader_build_summary()` 扫描 skills 目录全部 `.md`，取每个文件的标题（`# 首行`）和首段描述（标题到首个空行之间）拼成 skill 清单注入提示词。
26: 3. **意图匹配执行**：LLM 根据摘要匹配用户意图，再用 `read_file` 读取对应 skill 全文并照其步骤执行。
27: 4. **热加载**：`skill_loader_check_changed()` 对目录内文件名 + size + mtime 做哈希，检测到变化即重建摘要，无需重启 Agent。
28: 
29: ## 同名覆盖语义
30: 
31: 团队自研的 `daily-briefing.md`、`reminder.md`、`note-taker.md` 与内置 skill 同名，`health-reminder.md` 为纯新增。
32: 
33: **覆盖依赖于"内置只写不覆盖"这一行为**：由于 `install_builtin()` 对已存在的同名文件直接跳过，只要团队版先于 Agent 首次启动部署到 `<BASE>/skills/`，内置版就永远不会被写入，等效于屏蔽。
34: 
35: **注意**：若 Agent 已启动过，设备上可能已存在内置版同名文件。用 `deploy_assets.ps1` 部署时首条写入以 `>` 覆盖，会整体替换设备端文件内容，因此任何时机部署都能得到团队版；若用其他方式（如手工追加写入）部署，则需先删除设备上的同名文件再写入，确保落盘的是团队版。
36: 
37: `health-reminder.md` 与内置列表不重名，直接放入 skills 目录即为纯新增，无任何冲突。

39: ## 与 cron / SOUL / USER / MEMORY 的关系
40: 
41: - `SOUL.md`、`USER.md`、`MEMORY.md` 不走 skill 机制，由 `context_builder.c` 直接拼入 system prompt（人格、用户、长期记忆），路径见上表。
42: - `cron.json` 由 cron_service 加载（schema 见 `cron_service.c` 的 `cron_parse_job_item`：`id`/`name`/`kind`/`message` 必填）。到期触发时，若 job 带 `action` 则直接执行同名**已注册工具**；无 `action` 则把 `message` 原文推送到 channel——**cron 触发不经过 LLM**。因此每日简报任务推的是引导文案，用户回复后由 LLM 匹配到 daily-briefing skill 生成真实简报——**cron 是触发器，skill 是执行脚本**。
43: - 各 skill 内部的步骤（读写 MEMORY.md、cron_add 创建提醒等）与上述文件协同，因此部署时建议整套一起推送，避免版本错配。

1: # Skills 系统

3: Skills 是 Markdown 格式的可扩展技能，告诉 Agent 在特定场景下如何使用工具完成任务。

5: ## 架构
6:

8: /data/agent/skills/
9: ├── weather.md          ← 内置（首次启动自动安装）

# openvela AI Agent — Investigation Report

All paths absolute. Citations are `file:line`.

---

## 1. Weather tool

**Registered name:** `get_weather` (exactly one).
- Registration: `tool_registry.c:200-206` — name `"get_weather"`, description `"Get current weather for a location."`
- Params: single required string `location` (`"City name or location, e.g. 'Shanghai' or 'New York'"`) — `tool_registry.c:203-205`.
- Handler: `tool_get_weather_execute` (`tool_web_search.c:551-596`), input JSON `{ "location": "Shanghai" }` (`tool_web_search.c:547`).

**Backends / keys:** It is NOT a real weather API. It builds the query `"<location> weather today"` (`tool_web_search.c:572-573`) and runs a web search:
- Tavily first: `tool_web_search.c:575-582`
- SerpAPI fallback: `tool_web_search.c:584-590`
- **Exa is NOT used for weather.**
- Needs a Tavily or SerpAPI key. If neither: error `"Error: Could not fetch weather for '%s'. Set key via set_tavily_key or set_search_key."` (`tool_web_search.c:592-594`). Keys come from build-time `AGENT_SECRET_TAVILY_KEY` / `AGENT_SECRET_SERP_KEY` (`agent_config.h:65-72`) or runtime config keys `tavily_key`/`serp_key` (`tool_web_search.c:100-107`; `agent_config.h:241,243`).

**Exact returned format (plain text, NOT JSON):** numbered list, 5 results max (`tool_web_search.c:42-43,175-179`):
```
1. <title>
   <url>
   <content>

2. ...
```
- Tavily uses `title/url/content` (`tool_web_search.c:175-179`); SerpAPI uses `title/link/snippet` (`tool_web_search.c:244-248`).
- Empty results → `"No results found."` (`tool_web_search.c:162`).

**Fast path caveat (important):** user messages containing `"天气怎么样"`, `"weather"`, or `"天气如何"` bypass the LLM entirely and return raw `get_weather` output (`agent_loop.c:389-419`, execute at `:412`). No skill/LLM step runs for those phrases.

## 2. `write_file` tool

**Registered name:** `write_file` (`tool_registry.c:220-227`).
**Params:** required `path` (string) + `content` (string) (`tool_registry.c:223-226`); handler `tool_write_file_execute` (`tool_files.c:170-224`).

**Sandbox — writable paths:** any absolute path under `AGENT_DATA_DIR` (default `/data/agent`), excluding 3 protected files. Path is **absolute, NOT relative** to the data dir.

Path validation (`tool_files.c:46-83`), quoted:
```c
size_t dlen = strlen(AGENT_DATA_DIR);
/* Quick reject: raw path must at least start with data dir */
if (strncmp(path, AGENT_DATA_DIR, dlen) != 0
    || (path[dlen] != '/' && path[dlen] != '\0')) {
    return false;
}
/* Reject explicit traversal components */
if (strstr(path, "..") != NULL) {
    return false;
}
```
Then `realpath()` symlink-escape re-check (`tool_files.c:68-77`). Parent dirs auto-created under the data dir by `ensure_parent_dirs()` (`tool_files.c:115-129`).

Protected (cannot be overwritten): `config/config.json`, `config/SOUL.md`, `config/USER.md` (`tool_files.c:87-92`, enforced at `:187-193`).

**Can it create `<base>/WEATHER.md`?** **Yes.** `/data/agent/WEATHER.md` passes validation (starts with `/data/agent/`, no `..`, not in protected list). Absolute path required — `WEATHER.md` alone would fail.

## 3. Agent data dir

- Macro: `AGENT_DATA_DIR` = `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_AI_AGENT_VELA_DATA_DIR` (`agent_config.h:89`).
- Default value: `"/data/agent"` when Kconfig is unset (`agent_config.h:85-87`).
- No runtime fallback in code. Legacy firmware used `/data/ai_agent`; the deploy script auto-detects and can target either (`deploy_assets.ps1:49-51,257-268`).
- Derived: `AGENT_SKILLS_DIR = AGENT_DATA_DIR "/skills/"` (`agent_config.h:183`), memory/config paths `:90-96`.
- **No `workspace/` convention exists** — grep for `workspace` in `ai_agent` returned nothing. Files the LLM writes go directly under `/data/agent/` (e.g. built-in examples use `/data/agent/TASKS.md`, `/data/agent/memory/daily/...` — `skill_loader.c:145,193`).

```

**How the agent decides to follow it:** the skill mechanism is *advisory, not enforced*. Each system prompt includes a summary of all skills (title + first paragraph); the LLM must match intent and then `read_file` the full skill itself:
- Summary format: `"- **%s**: %s (read with: read_file %s)\n"` (`skill_loader.c:372-374`).
- Injected as `## Skills` section into the system prompt (`context_builder.c:171-177`).
- Docs confirm: "Agent 根据用户请求自动匹配合适的 Skill 并按其指引执行" (`docs/skills.md:39`); "Skill 不是代码，是给 Agent 的'操作手册'" (`docs/skills.md:33`).

**Skill format:** no YAML front-matter, no trigger field. Plain markdown with:
- Line 1 `# Title` (parsed as title, `skill_loader.c:267-284`)
- Description paragraph up to first blank line (`skill_loader.c:289-319`)
- Conventional sections `## When to use`, `## How to use`, `## Example` (`docs/skills.md:72-89`)

## 5. Skills loading

- Loaded from `<AGENT_DATA_DIR>/skills/` = `/data/agent/skills/` (`agent_config.h:183`; enumeration `skill_loader.c:328-375`).
- On startup `skill_loader_init()` creates the dir and installs 10 built-ins **only if the file does not already exist** (`skill_loader.c:246-259`; skip logic `:227-232`).
- The LLM gets **only the summary** (title + description) in the system prompt (`context_builder.c:173-177`) — **not** full skill text. Full text is fetched on demand via `read_file` (`skill_loader.c:373-374`).
- Hot reload: directory hash of name+size+mtime (`skill_loader.c:389-427`).
- Deploy semantics: team file placed before first boot wins; otherwise `deploy_assets.ps1` overwrites with `>` (`README.md:33-35`).

## 6. Mechanism to add "write weather to WEATHER.md"

**Recommendation: (a) edit `daily-briefing.md` to instruct the LLM to call `write_file`.** More reliable given this architecture:

- `write_file` is **already registered and available to the LLM by default** (`tool_registry.c:220-227`), included unconditionally in the tools JSON (`tool_registry.c:108-116`). No permission/approval gate, no allowlist entry needed.
- A skill is markdown and hot-reloads without rebuild (`skill_loader.c:443-449`), whereas adding a tool means C code + reflash.
- `/data/agent/WEATHER.md` is writable and unprotected (see §2).
- Precedent: built-in skills already instruct file writes (`skill_loader.c:96,107,147,195`; task-manager writes `/data/agent/TASKS.md` at `:193`).

**Suggested step to add** to `## 执行步骤` of `daily-briefing.md`, e.g. after step 3:
```
3b. 使用 write_file 将天气结果写入 /data/agent/WEATHER.md
    - path="/data/agent/WEATHER.md" content="<日期> <城市> <温度> <天气状况>"
```
Path must be absolute `/data/agent/WEATHER.md` (relative paths rejected, §2).

**Caveats / uncertainty (flag):**
- Skills are advisory; the LLM can skip steps. The fast path in `agent_loop.c:389-419` bypasses the LLM/skill for phrases like "天气怎么样", so WEATHER.md would not be written on those. The cron trigger also does not pass through the LLM (`README.md:42`).
- `AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS 2` (`agent_config.h:110`) may cap parallel tool calls per iteration; total tool iterations allowed is 10 (`AGENT_MAX_TOOL_ITER`, `agent_config.h:109`). I did not trace enforcement, so whether the extra write fits within call budgets is uncertain.
- If deterministic writing is required, option (b) — adding a dedicated tool or a cron `action` — would be needed; cron with `action=<tool>` executes the registered tool directly without the LLM (`README.md:42`). That is more reliable but requires C changes/flashing.

## 7. `tool_guard.c` — is `write_file` gated?

Yes, but only as "sensitive", not approval-gated:
- Classified `TOOL_SEC_SENSITIVE` (`tool_guard.c:41`).
- Subject to rate limiting: 10 calls / 60s window (`tool_guard.c:216-233`; limits `agent_config.h:392-393`).
- Can be disabled at runtime via config key `tool_enabled_write_file`; **default is enabled** when key absent (`tool_guard.c:261-277`).
- Input size cap 32 KB (`tool_guard.c:207-212`; `agent_config.h:391`).
- Guard is invoked before every tool execution (`tool_registry.c:536-563`).
- No interactive/user-approval mechanism exists in `tool_guard.c` — only disable, rate-limit, size, and injection checks (`tool_guard.h:27-40`).
